import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] a = new long[20];

    static long compute(long n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        int index = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i) {
            if (a[i] > n) {
                index = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        long result1 = (long)1e18;
        long result2 = (long)1e18;
        result1 = (n / a[index - 1]) * (index - 1) + compute(n % a[index - 1]);
        if (a[index] - n < n)
            result2 = index + compute(a[index] - n);
        return Math.min(result1, result2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
            a[i] = a[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        long number = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(compute(number));
        sc.close();
    }
}
